snippet.title: Legendary Pilots | Take to the Skies Anywhere
snippet.description:
Legendary Pilots is now available FREE on iOS and Android, letting you begin your journey as a rising pilot in a rich, stylised aviation world. Master routes, maintain your aircraft, and build your aviation career across the globe.

And for those looking for the full Legendary Pilots experience…
The expanded PC edition is coming soon to Steam, featuring deeper systems and a larger-scale aviation journey.

Wishlist now and be ready for takeoff.

👉 Steam page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393730/Legendary_Pilots/

👉 Mobile download links:
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/legendary-pilots/id6752300450

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.berkbox.lpilots
